pr.title: Fix static analysis under newer ty releases
pr.body:
The scheduled upgrade-checks workflow has been red since Aug 11 (#4812): newer ty releases flag `_CacheEntry[Tool]` in `ProxyProvider` because the class was annotated as a subscripted generic without actually being `Generic`. This makes it one, and clears the rest of the drift between the pinned and current ty so the two CI paths agree again.

Newer ty also narrows `isinstance` unions and dict accesses that the pinned 0.0.61 couldn't, leaving four suppression comments in `client/roots.py` and `utilities/json_schema.py` that old ty required and new ty rejects as unused — unsatisfiable from both sides. Bumping the pin to 0.0.69 (the newest release the one-week dependency cooldown allows) lets the suppressions come out entirely. Verified clean on ty 0.0.69, 0.0.70, and 0.0.71, so the upgrade job stays green as the cooldown window advances.

diff.patch:
@@ -14,7 +14,7 @@
 from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable, Sequence
 from copy import deepcopy
 from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
-from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Literal, cast
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Generic, Literal, TypeVar, cast
 
 import anyio
 import httpx2
@@ -819,12 +819,15 @@ def get_span_attributes(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
 # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
 
-class _CacheEntry:
+_ComponentT = TypeVar("_ComponentT")
+
+
+class _CacheEntry(Generic[_ComponentT]):
     """A cached sequence of components with a monotonic timestamp."""
 
     __slots__ = ("items", "timestamp")
 
-    def __init__(self, items: Sequence[Any], timestamp: float):
+    def __init__(self, items: Sequence[_ComponentT], timestamp: float):
         self.items = items
         self.timestamp = timestamp

@@ -610,19 +610,19 @@ def traverse_and_clean(
                 if (
                     prune_titles
                     and "title" in node
-                    and isinstance(node["title"], str)  # type: ignore
+                    and isinstance(node["title"], str)
                     and (
                         any(k in node for k in _SCHEMA_KEYWORDS)
                         or all(k in _METADATA_KEYS for k in node)
                     )
                 ):
-                    node.pop("title")  # type: ignore
+                    node.pop("title")
 
                 if (
                     prune_additional_properties
                     and node.get("additionalProperties") is False
                 ):
-                    node.pop("additionalProperties")  # type: ignore
+                    node.pop("additionalProperties")
 
             # Recursive traversal
             for key, value in node.items():
